meta.scene_rules: 生产806清砖变体；原生糖泡/道具；2400 tick；完整对局；无预置携包；assist-off
meta.selection_rule: predeclared seeds 2026101810..2026101815; all retained; no outcome selection
meta.reward_source: JE10 r01 g8 SOURCE_SEAL ledger on production Web transitions; offline CPU reconstruction; not historical training reward

metrics.selection_rule: original natural seed2026101800 plus predeclared native/open/carry_home seeds2026101810..2026101815; all retained; no outcome selection
metrics.limitations: offline_approximate_one_step：生产Web逐合法联合动作真实一步反事实，同状态/RNG快照、冻结实际对手动作；同checkpoint Actor与训练总奖励Critic。raw为继承H8任务账本（含原有运输塑形，JE10控制死亡修正保留），shaped再含JE10控制与路线PBRS。两侧共用total-reward Critic，raw不是独立原始任务Critic；ΔA是两种奖励口径的同Critic差，不是跨代Critic差。完整同版本账本从本局初态冷启动并逐步保存，事件来自Web、CPU安全检测来自封存训练源码，属于离线Web指标近似，非历史训练rollout。场景映射native=8/open=0/carry_home=2，Web时限与训练课程HORIZON不同；Web立即终局不追加训练危险残留结算tick，未结算余额不冒充已付奖励。训练ledger的D标签使用己半场，页面按真实3×3笼校正为C，Phi和Reward原值不改。

shaped_critic.legal_actions: production move mask x actor ability mask; masked-head probability product renormalized over all legal joint actions
